set.body: ThreeJsRuntime.clearFrame currently calls setClearColor(0xffffff, 1.0) on every frame. This makes an embedding scientific workspace show an opaque white rectangle and prevents product theming without reaching around ScalaFIM into Three.js. Add a typed, validated background/clear-colour option owned by surface-view-three, with the existing white as a compatibility default. It must be set through the runtime/host construction or a typed action, survive resize/render cycles, and remain renderer-neutral above the Three interpreter. Acceptance: Scala.js tests prove default white and a requested dark colour/alpha reach setClearColor; Neuropublish consumes it through its thin Laminar host with no direct Three.js mutation.
set.title: Make the surface-view clear colour a typed runtime option
